title: Product + pricing
headline: Rental and services is 82.5% of FY2025 total revenue (team calculation), but the documents we reviewed give no CPN rents, so we propose rules, not rent levels.

table.title: Four of the proposed tactics for FY2027
rows: [Proposed] Gen Z format zone at CenTRal cENtrAL: sport, racket sport, fitness, creator pop-ups
[Proposed] LEAD Year 9 favours Gen Z categories and sustainability; track pop-up-to-lease
[Proposed] Renewal: yearly rent rises inside TRIS Rating's 2–3% band; non-rent concessions first
[Proposed] Gen Z event access earned via CENTRAL X receipts, as State Your Style; cap vouchers

items.label: Bangkok prime asking rent/mo, Q3 2026; not CPN's

notes: Four of our proposed tactics: a Gen Z format zone, LEAD Year 9 favouring Gen Z categories, a renewal rule keeping rent rises inside TRIS Rating's band, and Gen Z event access through CENTRAL X receipts. State Your Style gave a 400 baht voucher per 4,500 baht spent, 8.9 percent by our calculation; vouchers are capped. Rental and services was 43,721 million baht in 2025, 82.5 percent of total revenue by our calculation. In the documents we reviewed CPN publishes no rents, so we propose no rent levels. The 3,769 baht is a Bangkok prime asking rent per square metre a month, not CPN's.
